text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In 1st place is <chrname>!
<chrname> reaches the goooal!!

text_block_list.name: Stream Chat
text_block_list.text:
"Wait. Seriously? She won?"
"Her opponent was pretty strong, right?
For <chrname> to beat her..."

text_block_list.name: Stream Chat
text_block_list.text:
""...We might just have a shot at winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."
"We might actually win on French turf.""

text_block_list.name: Stream Chat
text_block_list.text: "<chrname>, you might just be able to do this."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, everyone's here.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now then, ahead of next month's overseas expedition,
I will announce the runners for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

Clutching my chest,
I step up beside <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: As I mentioned the other day, the objective of this project is victory in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, the members recommended for the overseas expedition
are strictly narrowed down to 'those who can win.'

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However! Even if they aren't called upon, let anyone who wishes to come accompany the overseas expedition!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying them! I want you to learn through
supporting the expedition members and spectating!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Now, I will make the announcement. First up is—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—<chrname>!
The four of you mentioned, report to the Director's office!

...Two distinct sets of footsteps echoed.
One was the sound of the group heading toward the Chairwoman's office.
And the other was—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Those who wish to participate in the overseas expedition,
come see me.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Those of you gathered here today
will be entering races starting next month
as 'Representatives of Japan.'

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
First, <chrname> will run
in the preparatory race, the Prix Niel.
Got that?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
We'll dismiss here for today.
Everyone, please get started on your preparations.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Halt! Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Phew~...
Thank goodness, I made it in time~.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "I was asked to deliver something to you all!"

The bag handed to me by Chairwoman Akikawa
contained cooling spray, ointment, compresses,
as well as sunglasses and snacks.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Apparently, this is an 'Expedition Set'.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: All the girls who weren't selected as representatives have volunteered to travel abroad as support.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "They told me they wanted to assist with your overseas training."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I want you to
accept their feelings."

After parting ways with Chairwoman Akikawa,
I unpacked the contents of the "Expedition Kit"
in the Trainer's Office.

Just then, a single sheet of paper
fluttered down onto the desk.

text_block_list.name: Message Card
text_block_list.text: "Do your best."

The edges of the letters
were slightly distorted.

—We have to hold our heads high and take on the challenge,
for the sake of the girls who weren't chosen.
That is what it means to be "Japan's representative".
